newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Saab U.S. car sales tumble 37 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Saab U.S. car sales tumble 37 pct in October.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker Saab Automobile said on Monday its U.S. car sales fell 37 percent in October to 1,478 units.
So far this year Saab has sold six percent more cars in the U.S. compared to the first 10 months in 1995 with a total 24,053 vehicles sold, Saab Automobile spokesman Olof Wallen told Reuters.
He said most cars in the U.S. were bought through instalment programmes and the company did not have such a payment programme available in October.
"In October we were not on par with our competitors. But measures are about to take place there," Wallen said.
Wallen compared the October figures with September sales levels when the company had an instalment programme in place.
Saab sold 2,874 cars in September in the U.S..
"Not having such a programme means rollercoaster sales figures. But we aim to correct this in the coming months," he said.
Saab sold 200 of its 9000 model in October in the U.S. compared with 800 in October 1995.
